benchmark.method: ABBA separate matched current-main baseline/candidate builds,120 GPU-completed frames after20warm frames; frozen simulation. Shared host load varies.

live_loop.method: ABBA 8s hidden real tick/present loop per run; final profile window after 5s initial live warmup. Same current-main control/candidate and private captured settings. Shared host load varies.
live_loop.aggregation: Final profile window only after approximately five seconds of live warmup; mean/profile values weighted by tail frame counts; worst values are maxima, not averages.
live_loop.caveat: Short hidden live tick/present check on a shared host; run ranges expose variation. It does not guarantee sustained FPS or 60 FPS and does not reproduce an exact screenshot camera.

ore_assets.scope: Only four approved ore runtime files in each of two installations

preservation_review.timing_review: Preset modification at 22:36 preceded this performance deployment. It is a concurrent tuning change and was preserved as found.
preservation_review.benchmark_policy: Benchmarks intentionally retain the captured original preset so matched control/candidate comparisons use identical original settings. The installed concurrent preset is not restored or overwritten.

caveats: Camera and seed reconstruct the scene approximately; the exact moved screenshot camera was not recorded.
ABBA measurements are GPU-completed frozen-frame rendering tests on a shared host; background load varies.
Signed frame-time reductions report the observed results, including zero gains or regressions; they do not establish guaranteed improvement.
These measurements do not guarantee live-match FPS or verify a 60 FPS target.
CPU shadow measurements exclude initialization and warmup; they are main-thread wall/driver attribution, not isolated GPU timestamps.
Measured runtime timing is macOS arm64; universal binaries include x86_64, whose runtime FPS was not measured.
The one historical preset difference was reviewed as a concurrent tuning update before deployment and preserved as found. Matched benchmarks intentionally use the captured original preset.
